Chapter 1: Subscription Data 13 Section A: Access Service – An overview 1. The number of telephone subscribers in India increased from 1,199.28 million at the end of Mar-24 to 1,200.80 million at the end of Mar-25, registering a yearly growth rate of 0.13%. The overall Tele-density in India decreased from 85.69% at the end of Mar-24 to 85.04% at the end of Mar-25 at yearly rate of decline of 0.75%. 2. Telephone subscription in Urban Areas increased from 665.38 million at the end of Mar-24 to 666.11 million at the end of Mar-25 at the yearly growth rate of 0.11%. However, Urban Tele-density decreased from 133.72% at the end of Mar-24 to 131.45% at the end of Mar-25 with yearly rate of decline of 1.70%. 3. Rural telephone subscription increased from 533.90 million at the end of Mar-24 to 534.69 million at the end of Mar-25 at the yearly rate of growth of 0.15%. However, Rural Tele-density decreased from 59.19% at the end of Mar-24 to 59.06% at the end of Mar-25 with yearly rate of decline of 0.22%.
